# RHS AI Solutions OS

> Property Intelligence & Operational Compliance OS — a multi-tenant B2B platform built by RHS AI Solutions, a business name of Right Hand Services by JP (Candor, North Carolina).

RHS AI Solutions OS helps property, vegetation and right-of-way management companies run site intelligence and operational compliance from one control center. Each company gets an isolated tenant workspace; screening-level sample audits are complimentary and full audits require an active workspace.

## Features

- **AI site intelligence**: condition audits with turf-health and drainage-flow grading per parcel. Aerial imagery is AI-generated for illustration — it is not satellite, drone or survey data, and audit scores are simulated estimates.
- **Compliance ledger**: multi-tenant log of vegetation overgrowth, drainage issues and routine audits with severity, resolution status and due dates.
- **AEO tracker (simulated)**: visibility rank and recommendation snippets are produced by an LLM simulation of AI answer-engine responses (Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity) — not live engine queries. Treat them as directional estimates only.
- **Smart invoicing**: invoice issuance with payment status tracking and revenue analytics.
- **Tiered SaaS billing**: Free Discovery (5 properties / 1 AEO keyword), Professional at $149/mo (50 / 10), Enterprise at $499/mo (unlimited).

## Who it is for

Commercial property groups, HOA/property managers, municipalities and vegetation-management contractors that need audited site condition data, a shared compliance ledger, and proof of work for invoicing.

## Access

The control center requires signing in with a corporate email (consumer domains are restricted). The public page describes the platform and offers a complimentary screening-level sample audit.
